Native familywise simultaneous calibration of fixed-target FPCR projections

etr_native_wild_simultaneous_source_calibration.Rd

Pure native R postcalibration of precomputed Gaussian FPCR wild-bootstrap studentized roots with one max-absolute statistic over the complete predeclared family of fixed target trajectories. No model or multiplier generation is performed.

Usage

etr_fpca_wild_bootstrap_projection_simultaneous_interval(
  result, confidence_level = NULL)

Arguments

result

Native scientific list containing the base wild-bootstrap projection result, finite B-by-N studentized roots, finite reference projections and nonnegative reference standard errors, fixed target identifiers and predeclared confidence level.

confidence_level

Numeric probability in (0,1). When NULL, use the base result's existing confidence level.

Value

An R scientific record of per-target critical values, familywise max-absolute bootstrap statistics, the common simultaneous critical value and reference projection intervals on exactly the retained fixed-target family. The source Python 1.2 dataclass output type is not claimed.

Details

Quantiles use the published NumPy method="higher" rule, selecting ceiling((B-1)*confidence_level)+1 in R's one-based sorted bootstrap order. This differs from some default R quantile rules for finite B. The function reuses the retained bootstrap data; it does not rerun FPCA, Gaussian FPCR or residual multipliers, change fixed targets, account for component-selection uncertainty, calibrate future outcomes, or claim between-target or between-grid coverage. Source-contract representation and complete input-domain equivalence remain independently uncertified.
